card.name: "of" after be aware / inform of
card.fires_on: The word "of" or "the" right after "be aware" or "inform/informed ... of" in warning sentences, just before a named risk or symptom. Also once on "ally" in "temporally related".

modes.label: The phrase "be aware of"
modes.description: "of" after "should be aware" in clinician advice about possible reactions.
modes.example: The clinician should, nevertheless, be aware<< of>> the possibility of emergent symptoms of serotonin

modes.label: The phrase "inform patients of the"
modes.description: "the" after "inform patients of" or "informed by the physician of", before risks or warning signs.
modes.example: Inform patients of<< the>> warning signs and symptoms of hepatotoxicity

card.plain: It responds to the little word after "be aware" or "inform of" that leads into a risk or warning sign.
